label: Local Models
description: Local OpenAI-compatible runtimes such as LM Studio, llama.cpp servers, text-generation-webui, vLLM, and custom LAN endpoints.
quota_status: Local runtime; constrained by installed models, memory, disk, and the configured endpoint.
